'''Wain Andrell''' was a [[Human/Legends|Human]] [[Gender/Legends|male]] [[Senator/Legends|senator]] who represented the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Ralltiir/Legends|Ralltiir]] in the [[Galactic Senate/Legends|Galactic Senate]] of the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Republic]] during the [[Cold War (Galactic Republic–Sith Empire)|Cold War]]. He was the father of [[Momi Andrell]], who used his wealth to hire mercenaries to save endangered species.

In [[3643 BBY]], Wain sent a message to a [[Voidhound|smuggler]] who saved his daughter after she was infected with theoretically incurable diseases by the sadistic Doctor [[Lazhae]]. He had hired the best scientists in the galaxy in hopes of curing her, but was relieved that this would put her extremist goals on hold.
